decisions.reason: The single-tube air fin cooler is core to the air-cooled heat exchange portfolio and supports the efficiency strategy for process and energy customers at low incremental cost.
With Product B already withdrawn, Product C is now the remaining single-tube air cooled condenser variant, so it is the consolidated offering and is likely to stay.
Liners for corroded tubes feed the high-margin lifecycle repair business that is central to the firm's service strategy.
The customized industrial air cooler line with several models embodies the firm's integrated, customized solutions approach across many customer segments.
Tube end repair inserts strengthen the spare parts and repair offering and extend equipment life with minimal ongoing resource needs.
